title: Wonder Woman and the golden lasso.
lines: On a secret island in the sea only women live.
A girl lives on the island.
She learns to run, jump and swim.
She learns archery and horse riding.
She's the fastest of them all.
One day something falls out of the sky.
Steve tells her about the world outside the island.
Two silver bracelets that stop anything.
Whoever holds that lasso can only tell the truth.
Diana puts on a suit, red and blue, with a golden star.
Diana and Steve sail to the big city.
She tastes an ice cream for the first time.
But something is going on in the city.
A man has built a big machine.
The machine makes people angry with each other.
Wonder Woman goes to the machine.
A guard shoots beams of light at her.
She throws the golden lasso around him.
The man has to tell the truth.
Nobody wanted to be my friend.
I wanted everyone else to feel bad too.
Wonder Woman looks at him kindly.
The man switches off the machine.
Now Wonder Woman knows what her power is.
But also believing in the good in everyone.
